title: [Decision] pm-dispatch: which PRs owe a `Skills-docs:` line (the #26184 audit Part B rule draft) — protocol-kind only, protocol-kind plus narrowing, or not adopted
body:
Ruled: 6431004737 · letter B · 2026-10-27T01:00Z

Filing gate ②: a maintainer-only decision (a pm-dispatch rule change; human-ruling floor #25344). Maintainer, 2026-10-27, verbatim: 「立决策卡」. The draft is #26184's audit Part B (comment 6425690779, `session_01C2Uuz8d9KeZ7qEYm6ZYWHL`), which asked for a ruling. Root ask, 2026-10-26: 「我不问你你也想不到立卡，如何避免出现类似的情况，需要更新 skills吗」. Filed by the triage seat (`session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U`, seat post #6015). ⛔ Not a claim.

## 维护者速读

昨天你问「我不问你你也想不到立卡，怎么避免」。审计 #26184 量到：18.0.0 以来 60 个带协议种类声明的提交，只有 3 个碰过 skills，而且只是改了锚点，所以留下 8 个包、26 行的教学缺口。第二部分的草案是：协议类 PR 的正文多写一行 `Skills-docs:`，取值四选一——本 PR 已更新、欠后续（列文件）、后续卡 #N、不需要（写理由）。席位验收时这行不在、或不属实，就不放行。**不加门禁、不加脚本**，净增 0 行，只扩写四处现有句子。请裁：**A** 只对协议种类为 added、semantic、narrowed 的 PR 要求这行；**B** A 再加上 `Clause-②` 带收窄声明的 PR，能抓住审计里漏掉的那一行 D5；**C** 不采纳，维持靠人提醒。选 A / B / C？

## Governing text

- `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md:313` (the claim template's `Metadata-protocol:` line) and `:191` (the six ACCEPT checks). `.claude/agents/os-dev.md:279` (Definition of done). `references/review-checklist.md:17` and `references/triage-duties.md:58`.
- 「新增门禁默认否」: the draft adds no gate. The line is read by the seat, and no script parses it (`scripts/pm/clause2-line.mjs` reads only `Clause-②:` and `Metadata-protocol:`).

## Premises (from Part A and Part B, read on `main` `be531f685e`)

- P1. 60 commits since the 18.0.0 tag carry a protocol kind other than `none`. 3 of them touched `skills/**`, and only anchors or key lists.
- P2. Row D5 (a position grants only the sets its `permissionSets` names) came from a PR declared `Metadata-protocol: none` with `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)`. A kind-only trigger misses it.
- P3. Every file the draft touches is at its line ceiling (headroom 0), so each item widens an existing line in place.
- P4. Two in-flight edits share the lane: #26155 (queued) and PR #26286 (open). The PR rebases on both, or rides #26155.

## Options

| Option | What | Consequence | Workload |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| **A** | The line is owed when `Metadata-protocol:` is `added`, `semantic` or `narrowed`. | It catches the common case and misses D5-type runtime narrowings. | skills · 1 PR (Tier S, `.claude/**`, a fable contract review) · 4 lines widened |
| **B** | A, plus any PR whose `Clause-②:` carries `(narrowing)`. | It catches D5 too. A breaking PR that changes nothing an author writes pays one `Skills-docs: none — REASON` line. | same as A |
| **C** | Not adopted. | The gap regrows. Follow-ups depend on someone asking, as happened on #26178 and #26179. | none |

## Recommendation

**B**, the audit's recommendation. Since 2026-10-26 the triage seat has already written "skills + docs + eval owed" by hand on protocol cards, and #26347 and #26362 are the first cards filed that way. B moves that habit into the dev's PR body and the seat's ACCEPT, so it no longer depends on triage remembering.

## After the ruling

`domain:skills` dispatches one Tier S PR with the four widened lines (Part B items 1–4; drop the narrowing words for A). Contract review runs at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`. No back-fill: the eight Part A cards are the back-fill.

os-decision-facets
① 项目长远合理性：B 把「协议改动要补 skills/文档/eval」从靠人提醒变成 PR 正文的一行声明，净增 0 行，不新增特例。
② 实际业务拉动：审计实测 26 行教学缺口、8 个包；#26178、#26179 都是你问了之后才立的卡。
③ 防 AI 犯错：取值是闭合的四选一，席位验收时缺行或不属实就拒绝放行（响亮拒绝）；不靠脚本，所以不新增门禁。
④ 创业阶段不扩散：零门禁、零脚本、零账本；不回填已合入的 PR，8 张审计卡就是回填。
